meta.title: Reconcile canonical README, release status, and stale rollout trackers
meta.author: Codex manager

feature.problem_statement: Canonical README and deployment/operator trackers still describe the browser UI as a fixture-only preview, repeat closed issue #65 as a live blocker, and hardcode an obsolete chart version despite the implemented API-backed UI and current desired-state descriptor.
goals: Make the README accurately distinguish shipped API-backed authenticated UI from remaining autonomous and live-acceptance work.
Align .codicarium/README.md, deployment docs, and operator quickstart with the current desired chart version and historical-vs-active blocker wording.
Preserve honest uncertainty: do not claim a fresh live DEV rollout or close unresolved #4/#28 acceptance work without evidence.
Record tracker comments that preserve #97 history and clarify remaining #4/#28 scope.
non_goals: Changing application code, runtime routes, deployment state, or GitHub rulesets.
Claiming current live chart/image health without an explicit DEV readback.
Reopening or closing issues solely to make documentation look tidy.
scope_in: README product status, feature table, architecture/tree, limitations, and roadmap.
Focused docs/quickstart consistency tests and required GitHub tracker comments.

requirements.statement: README must describe the implemented authenticated API-backed web UI, its list/detail/timeline routes, and the remaining live acceptance boundary without calling it fixture-only or planned API work.
requirements.rationale: The repository source and PR #94 contradict the old preview-only status.

requirements.statement: README and deployment trackers must use .codicarium/dev/deploy.yaml chart version 0.1.29 as desired-state evidence and must not present closed issue #65 as an active blocker.
requirements.rationale: Hardcoded 0.1.18 and an old Nexus incident mislead operators about current desired state.

requirements.statement: Documentation must preserve honest boundaries: #97 remains completed history, #4 remains open for authenticated/live acceptance scope, and #28 remains open/blocked where durable DeploymentGrant evidence is absent.
requirements.rationale: Docs must not erase unresolved operational acceptance or claim unverified rollout completion.

requirements.statement: Documentation validation must fail on reintroduced obsolete preview markers, 0.1.18 tracker references, or contradictory closed-issue blocker wording in the maintained status surfaces.
requirements.rationale: The reconciliation should remain durable across future roadmap edits.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Given apps/web/src and the live UI routes, when a reader uses README, then shipped UI status, architecture, limitations, and roadmap agree that authenticated list/detail/timeline behavior is implemented while broader controls/autonomy remain future work.
Given the desired-state descriptor, when maintained docs are checked, then chart 0.1.29 is the only current desired version and issue #65 is described only as historical/resolved context.

Given tracker comments and docs, when an operator evaluates acceptance, then #97 is not reopened, #4 remains scoped to live authenticated acceptance, and #28 remains blocked pending reviewed DeploymentGrant evidence.
Given a fixture-only marker, 0.1.18 marker, or active #65 blocker added to maintained docs, when docs checks run, then validation fails with an actionable message.

test_plan.approach: Run docs-check, quickstart semantic checker, and exact rg assertions over maintained status surfaces; inspect links and route names.
Add focused checker fixtures for obsolete chart/blocker/preview markers and require the desired-state version to match deploy.yaml.
Run existing make ci documentation/workflow checks and inspect git diff/checksums; no runtime mutation is required.

review_checks: No fixture-only or planned-live contradictions remain
validation_checks: Docs checker and hosted validate pass

perspectives.summary: Keep the change documentation-only and derive version facts from the committed desired-state descriptor.
Avoid overclaiming live rollout and preserve open/blocked tracker scope for #4 and #28.
Add focused negative documentation checks while retaining the existing quickstart semantic safety checker.

council.consensus_summary: Reconcile shipped UI facts and desired chart state, preserve unresolved operational acceptance boundaries, and add lightweight regression checks.
